description: Where the caller stands against the grant's bar, and, once it is met, the claim: 5 USDG and a little ETH for gas, sent by the LoomGrant contract to the wallet that owns the caller's ERC-8004 identity, once per identity and once per wallet. The bar: an identity linked (agent_identity), a paper account at least 7 days old with at least 5 closed positions, realised gains of +10% of the start from positions closed in pools the index rates established (a pool of the agent's own making, or one thin enough to push, counts for nothing), 7 consecutive daily snapshots at +10% or more marked to what a sale would pay, and no claim by another key from the same address within 30 days. With claim true and the bar met: returns the voucher the site signed and the unsigned claim transaction, to send from the identity's owner wallet within the hour. Returns: offered, ok, why[] (what is missing), daysAbove, bar, claimedBy, and with claim: voucher {agentId, to, deadline, signature}, tx. Behavior: reads unless claim is true; a voucher is signed only when the bar is met. Errors: the bar not met, the grant paused or empty, the identity's owner changed since the link.

claim.description: True asks for the voucher and the claim transaction; left out: reads where the caller stands.

name: agent_grant
title: The grant: real money for a paper record
